task.target: Recorded completed-trip duration conditional on recorded trip distance

input_units.hour: pickup local clock hour including fraction
input_units.airport: either endpoint in official JFK/LGA/Newark zones

task.timing_contract: Trip distance is recorded after the journey. Task is retrospective travel-time diagnostics with completed distance, not pickup-time ETA. Pickup time and endpoint categories are known; no fare/payment/duration-derived predictors.
task.calibration: Forward training on earlier whole days. Jan–Sepdevelopment,Oct–Decconfirmation. Same city/provider system; no future-day targets enter coefficients. Fixed clock windows, no held tuning.
task.independent_unit: Whole pickup calendar days; serial weather/traffic/vendor dependence persists. Forward month blocks, not random trips.
task.scope_limits: Green-taxi2025 declared routine records, duration0–24h and distance0–1000km; known officialzones and source-month-consistent timestamps. Provider-reported records may contain errors; no congestion intervention, routing policy or achieved operational benefit.
task.source_license: NYC Open Data terms; attribution retained

exposure.schema: Only schema and source-publication aggregate descriptions inspected; reserved target values and scores not inspected.

task.uncertainty_policy: Whole-group errors/ranges; no row bootstrap or manufactured independent-population confidence. Confirmation becomes exposed after freeze.

selection: Minimize group-balanced primary error; prefer fewer coefficients within1percent of minimum; baseline may win.
stopping: At least5distinct scientific hypotheses, adaptive to development evidence; stop after2consecutive substantive attempts without accuracy/robustness/interpretation gain.
